STATUS: VOID — DO NOT QUOTE ANY NUMBER FROM THIS FILE
why: A session-limit exhaustion killed 33 of 49 agents mid-run. The runner then mapped each dead agent's null return to a clean zero-finding lens with `errored` unset, so the harness scored rounds in which most lenses never ran. Kept as evidence of the defect, not as a result.
tells: Every control reports findings:0 AND nothingFound:false AND errored:false — impossible for a healthy agent, and the signature of a swallowed null.
sd-15 reports converged:true with zero findings, i.e. the runner called a round clean in which nothing ran.
erroredSeeds was empty despite 33 agent failures, because the failures were inside rounds that still returned.
whyTheBlindSpotIsSuspect: sd-15's lenses appear to have died rather than looked and missed, so calling it a blind spot would have been a fabricated negative result — the most misleading output this harness could produce.
fix: adversarial-review.js now treats a null or malformed agent result as errored (agent() RETURNS null on a terminal API error; it does not throw, so .catch never fired). mutation-recall.js now excludes any round with a dead lens from the denominator and emits denominatorWarning.
